title: 'Killed Again, Mr. Detective?' Manga's Inaba Launches New Manga
content: The November issue of Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine revealed last Friday that manga creator Inaba will launch a new manga titled Nukedashi ~Renai Kinshi no Kotō de Ore wa Ajin Joshi to Chome Chome Suru~ (Break Free ~Doing This and That With Demi-Human Girls on a Lonely Island Where Romance is Forbidden) in…
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at New Fights & Forms
content: Black Clover Season 2 has officially kicked off its return with new episodes this Fall, and the newest preview for Episode 3 of the anime is setting up some big new fights and transformations.
author: ComicBook

title: Erica Sakurazawa Launches New Manga on November 6
content: The November issue of Shodensha 's Feel Young magazine announced on Thursday that manga creator Erica Sakurazawa will launch a new manga titled Watashi no Manga (Mayoi) Michi (My [Lost] Road to Manga) in the magazine's next issue on November 6.
author: ANN

title: Blue Thermal's Kana Ozawa Announces New Manga
content: Manga creator Kana Ozawa announced on their X (formerly Twitter ) account on Thursday a new manga titled Ao Sansan (Blue Brilliance), which will start serialization in December. Other details such as the manga's publication medium will be revealed at a later date.
author: ANN

title: It’s Official, Nue’s Exorcist Is Finally Getting Its Own Anime – Watch First Look Trailer
content: It’s been three years since Nue’s Exorcist first made its debut with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and now it’s finally confirmed to be getting its own anime adaptation coming our way next year.
author: ComicBook

title: Spy×Family, Jujutsu Kaisen, Witch Hat Atelier Manga Rank on NYT October Bestseller List
content: The manga on this month's list include: • #6 — Tatsuya Endō's SPY x FAMILY volume 16 • #10 — Gege Akutami's Jujutsu Kaisen volume 1 • #15 — Kamome Shirahama's Witch Hat Atelier: Grimoire Edition hardcover volume 2 The first volume of Jujutsu Kaisen ranked at #7 in September.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Releases New Trailer for 2027’s Most Viral Anime Yet
content: 2027 is only a few months away, bringing with it a new wave of anime, and with Crunchyroll being the major streaming platform for anime, it will be the primary destination for many of these upcoming series.
author: ComicBook

title: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend Anime Reveals Key Visual, Main Cast
content: Noa Is My Senior and My Friend anime revealed a key visual and its main cast. Studio feel. is animating the series, set to premiere in 2027 and it stars Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome and Tomoya Ito as Rihito Otsuka. Shinsuke Yanagi is directing the anime with Keiichiro Ochi is writing the series scripts.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Nue no Onmyouji' Gets TV Anime in Summer 2027
content: The sixth Jump Press livestream event announced a television anime adaptation of Kouta Kawae 's Nue no Onmyouji ( Nue's Exorcist ) manga on Monday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promotional video. The anime is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi in Summer 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
